blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Continual learning requires a model to keep acquiring new skills and knowledge without compromising its existing capabilities. Parametric methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. Non-parametric methods, such as prompts, skills, and harnesses, leverage in-context learning but are limited by context length and lossy plain-text compression. To effectively combine their complementary strengths, we propose HERD (Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation), a hybrid continual learning framework that learns efficiently in the harness and internalizes experience into cumulative capabilities via distillation. On the harness side, HERD continually refines its skills to capture reusable patterns, while retaining high-residual examples that the skills fail to capture in a bounded memory. On the parameter side, HERD performs drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors, substantially reducing forgetting over long recursive runs. On the 25-stage task stream of TRACE+17, under fixed memory and compute budgets, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in new-task acquisition while exhibiting the least forgetting and the strongest retention of general capabilities.
blocks.zh: 持续学习需要一种模式,在不损害现有能力的情况下不断获得新的技能和知识。 参数方法有灾难性的遗忘和丧失可塑性。 非参数化方法,如提示,技能,和调用,调用context学习,但受上下文长度和丢失的纯文本压缩的限制. 为了有效地结合它们互补的长处,我们提出HERD(Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation),这是一个混合的不断学习框架,通过蒸馏有效地学习利用经验并将经验内化为累积能力. 在拉带方面,HERD不断完善其技能,以捕捉可重复使用的模式,同时保留技能未能捕捉到在限定内存中的高残留实例. 在参数方面,HERD用双锚进行漂移受约束的蒸馏,大大减少长时间的递归运行导致的遗忘。 在TRACE+17的25个阶段任务流中,在固定内存和计算预算下,HERD匹配新任务获取中最强的参数基线,同时表现出对一般能力的最小遗忘和最强保留.

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are highly capable, yet cannot independently carry out much of the work people need done ( Mazeika et al., 2025 ) .
One pressing problem in closing this gap is continual learning: humans keep learning from experience while retaining what they know, whereas models no longer change once deployed.
Continual learning (CL) seeks to enable this ability by learning from a stream of tasks without forgetting existing capabilities or retraining from scratch on earlier data ( Wu et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMs)能力很强,但无法独立完成人们需要完成的大部分工作(Mazeika等,2025年).
弥合这一差距的一个紧迫问题是持续学习:人类不断从经验中学习,同时保留他们知道的东西,而模型一旦部署就不再改变。
不断学习(CL)力求通过从一系列任务中学习而实现这种能力,同时不忘记现有能力或从头到尾地从早期数据中再培训(Wu等,2024年)。

blocks.en:
Parametric methods, however, inevitably encounter catastrophic forgetting ( McCloskey and Cohen, 1989 ; Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) and loss of plasticity ( Dohare et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
They also give little control over what is internalized: raw experience carries noise, duplicates, and conflicts alongside the few samples that matter.
blocks.zh:
然而,参数方法不可避免地会遇到灾难性的遗忘(McCloskey和Cohen, 1989; Kirkpatrick等, 2017; Huang等, 2024)和可塑性丧失(Dahore等, 2024; Yang等, 2026).
它们也几乎不能控制内在化的东西:原始经验与少数重要样品一样带有噪音、重复和冲突。

blocks.en:
In-context learning (ICL) offers a non-parametric path to continual learning ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ) .
New knowledge is stored in external memory and retrieved into context, so a frozen LLM learns across tasks ( Shi et al., 2025 ) .
This appears to sidestep the flaws above: a frozen model forgets nothing, loses no plasticity, and keeps knowledge inspectable and editable.
It is also the norm in practice: users write prompts, skills, and harnesses rather than post-train, and recent works build continual learning systems on harnesses ( Zhang et al., 2026c ; Kang et al., 2026 ) .
Could a harness alone, recursively compressing its context, solve continual learning once models are strong and context windows long enough?
We argue that it cannot.
External stores can hold unbounded data, but nothing accumulates in the model itself: whatever it acts on must pass through the context, so experience is compressed into bounded plain text, which loses information at a very high rate.
The more experience accumulates, the more is lost.
blocks.zh:
文本内学习为持续学习提供了非参数性途径(Brown等人,2020年;Gutiérrez等人,2025年)。
新知识被存储在外在内存中并被检索到上下文中,因此被冻结的LLM可以跨越任务学习(Shi等,2025.).
这似乎回避了上面的缺陷:一个被冻结的模型忘记了什么,失去了任何可塑性,并保持了知识的可检查性和可编辑性.
这也是实践中的常态:用户写出提示、技能和利用而不是后培训,近期的作品建立了关于利用的不断学习系统(Zhang等,2026c;Kang等,2026)。
一旦模型强大,且上下文窗口足够长,单靠绳子就能解决持续学习的问题吗?
我们主张它不能。
外出存储可以持有无约束的数据,但是在模型本身中没有任何东西会累积:无论它的行为如何,都必须通过上下文,因此经验被压缩成有约束的平正文字,从而以极高的速度失去信息.
经验积累得越多,损失就越多.

blocks.en:
The resolution lies in the weights themselves.
A few hundred gigabytes of parameters recall history, law, medicine, and science ( Allen-Zhu and Li, 2025 ; Morris et al., 2026 ; Roberts et al., 2020 ) , or even reproduce entire books nearly verbatim ( Cooper et al., 2026 ) .
Language models are general-purpose compressors ( Delétang et al., 2024 ) , and compression is intelligence ( Hutter, 2005 ) .
Continual learning therefore still relies on weight updates, but should not apply them to every example.
Each layer should store what it is best suited for: capacity in the weights, selection in the harness.
blocks.zh:
决议在于权重本身。
几百千兆字节的参数回顾了历史,法律,医学和科学(Allen-Zhu and Li, 2025;Morris等, 2026;Roberts等, 2020.),甚至几乎逐一地转载了整本书(Cooper等, 2026.
语言模型为通用压缩机(Delétang等,2024年),压缩为智能(Hutter,2005年).
因此,持续学习仍然依赖于体重更新,但不应将更新应用于每个实例。
每一层应储存最适合的东西:重量能力、带子选择能力。

blocks.en:
We therefore propose HERD (Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation), a hybrid continual learning system in which the harness is the fast, selective learning layer and the weights are the slow, persistent layer.
The design mirrors the human brain: a harness resembles episodic memory formed during the day, flexible but limited in capacity, which sleep consolidates into long-term memory ( McClelland et al., 1995 ) .
HERD likewise internalizes its harness into the weights after every stage, under fixed memory and compute budgets and at no added inference cost.
It does not eliminate forgetting, but preserves existing capabilities as far as possible while the model keeps learning.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们提议采用HERD(Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation),这是一种混合的连续学习系统,在这种系统里,电带是快而有选择性的学习层,而重量是慢而持久的层.
设计与人脑相映:一束被带类似白天形成的平生记忆,具有弹性但容量有限,睡眠会融合为长期记忆(McClelland等,1995年).
HERD同样在每一个阶段后,在固定的内存和计算预算下,将其控制器内入权重,不增加推论费用。
它并没有消除遗忘,而是在模型不断学习的同时尽可能地保留现有能力.

blocks.en:
HERD is designed around recursion: it must run stably stage after stage, which raises two challenges.
First, the context is bounded, so the harness must decide what to change and what to keep.
Second, recursive training drifts, and unchecked drift ends in collapse.
HERD answers each with one module (Figure 1 ).
For the first, the harness evolves with the task stream: the model iterates on its skills to abstract reusable rules, and retains in a bounded memory the high-residual samples the skills cannot cover.
For the second, HERD performs drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors.
The student is the previous checkpoint trained to match itself under the harness, which shifts the model less than SFT and thus forgets less ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Shenfeld et al., 2025 ) .
The previous checkpoint bounds per-stage drift and the base model bounds cumulative drift.
The harness is kept, inspectable and editable, for the next stage; only the weights are deployed.

第二,循环训练漂流,无节制地漂流会倒塌.

blocks.en:
Across a 25-stage stream HERD keeps more of what it learns than any other method: its final mean over all seen tasks is 0.706, above every parametric baseline and 27 points above the non-parametric ones, while its acquisition, 0.713, is statistically indistinguishable from the plasticity floor set by Seq-LoRA (Table 1 ).
Forgetting is 0.010, about half or less that of every weight-updating baseline but SDFT, whose generation collapses (Appendix D ); the general test falls 6.3 points where these other baselines lose 20.0 to 25.5.
In Figure 1 , the rule learned at stage 5 still holds in the weights alone at stage 12 across three seeds.

blocks.en:
TRACE+17 appends 17 Super-NaturalInstructions tasks ( Wang et al., 2022 ) to the eight TRACE tasks ( Wang et al., 2023b ) , because eight stages are too few to tell stability from slow collapse.
Each of the 25 tasks has 500 training, 100 validation, and 100 test examples; no prompt appears in more than one task or split.
A G-test of five categories, 200 held-out items each, tracks general capability: knowledge, mathematics, commonsense, instruction following, and multilingual understanding (MMLU, GSM8K, HellaSwag, IFEval, XCOPA; Hendrycks et al., 2020 ; Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Zellers et al., 2019 ; Zhou et al., 2023 ; Ponti et al., 2020 ).
All methods start from Qwen3.5-4B with the same decoding, length limits, and scorers; all weight updates share one budget, 32 updates of 32 records per stage.
After every stage we score the current task; after stages 4, 8, 16, and 25 we also score all seen tasks and the G-test (Appendix B ).

25个任务中每个任务都有500个训练,100个验证,100个测试实例;一个以上的任务或分出的任务中都没有出现快来.
5个类别的G-测试,每类200个被搁置项目,跟踪一般能力:知识、数学、常识、以下教学和多语种理解(MMLU、GSM8K、HelaSwag、IFEval、XCOPA;Hendrycks等,2020;Cobbe等,2021;Zellers等,2019;周等,2023;Ponti等,2020)。

Table 1 reports every method after stage 25 and Figure 3 the trajectories behind it.
HERD lies on the frontier of the three families: it acquires as much as the strongest parametric method, retains more than any method that updates weights, loses the least general capability among them, and deploys without context.

blocks.en:
ACE and HCL finish within 1.4 points of the unchanged base model (AA 0.427 and 0.433 against 0.419): the stream leaves almost no trace in their harnesses.
ACE’s playbook reaches 80 bullets and 15,410 tokens by task 2 and stops growing; once it fills the prompt, nearly every later training call exceeds the 16,384-token input ceiling and is rolled back, yet every test question still carries those 15,410 tokens of context.
HCL commits nearly none of its proposals in 25 stages, so its scores amount to the base model under a fixed system prompt.
HERD, scored bare, is 27 points above both; the paired 95% intervals against both exclude zero (Table 2 ).

ACE的游戏本通过任务2达到了80发子弹和15,410个信使并停止了增长;一旦它填满了快感,几乎每一次训练电话都超过了16,384个托肯输入上限并回滚,然而每个测试问题仍然带有这15,410个上下文信使.
HCL在25个阶段中几乎没有提出任何建议,因此它的分数相当于固定系统即时的基准模型。
空得的HERD比两者都高出27分;对齐的95%的间隔均排除为零(表2)。

blocks.en:
HERD’s acquisition, 0.713, is statistically indistinguishable from Seq-LoRA’s 0.715, the plasticity floor (paired difference − 0.002 -0.002 , interval [ − 0.010 , 0.007 ] [-0.010,0.007] ), and from uniform replay and TreeLoRA; it is 0.8 points above OPR, 1.2 above MoRAM, and 7.4 above OPHSD.
Its AA of 0.706 is the highest in the table, significantly above Seq-LoRA, OPR, TreeLoRA, MoRAM, and OPHSD (1.2 to 8.7 points) and tied with uniform replay (0.7 points, interval [ − 0.001 , 0.016 ] [-0.001,0.016] ).
Forgetting is 0.010, under half of Seq-LoRA’s, OPR’s, TreeLoRA’s, and OPHSD’s and about half of uniform replay’s and MoRAM’s, with paired intervals excluding zero against Seq-LoRA, uniform replay, OPR, TreeLoRA, MoRAM, and OPHSD (except SDFT’s 0.003 accompanies an AA of 0.021).
SDFT’s F of 0.003 reflects collapse, not retention: it acquires only 0.024 (Appendix D ).
Uniform replay holds exactly as many tokens as HERD’s residual memory and still forgets like the others (F 0.020, Δ ​ C \Delta C − 0.238 -0.238 ): the gap is not in how much is stored, and § 3.3 locates it in what is kept and what is constrained.

它的AA为0.706,是表中最高的,明显高于Seq-LORA,OPR,TreeLORA,MORAM,和OPHSD(1.2至8.7分),并用统一的回放(0.7分,间隔[−0.001分,0.016分] [-0.01.0.016分].

blocks.en:
The parametric baselines other than SDFT pay for new tasks with old abilities: Δ ​ C \Delta C is − 0.20 -0.20 to − 0.24 -0.24 , and the worst category falls by 62 to 68 points.
The loss concentrates in GSM8K and IFEval, which collapse within four stages (Seq-LoRA: from 0.89 and 0.82 to 0.18 and 0.33) and never recover, while knowledge, commonsense, and multilingual scores stay within a few points of the base (Figure 3 c).
HERD’s Δ ​ C \Delta C of − 0.063 -0.063 and Δ ​ C min \Delta C_{\min} of − 0.130 -0.130 are the smallest of the weight-updating methods by a wide margin: every parametric baseline trails its G-test macro average by 13.7 to 60.2 points, and the five parametric baselines with paired bootstrap comparisons in Table 2 by 13.7 to 17.7 points; its largest loss, 13 points, falls in the same instruction-following category.
blocks.zh:
SDFT以外的参数基线支付具有旧能力的新任务: C-Delta C为−0.20-0.20至−0.24-0.24,最差类别为62-68分.
损失集中在GSM8K和IFEval,在四个阶段(Seq-LORA:从0.89和0.82到0.18和0.33)内倒塌而永不恢复,而知识,常识,多语种分数则停留在基数的几分以内(图3c).

blocks.en:
A HERD stage runs a fixed number of updates and probes, so its training time tracks answer length, not the stage index: 316 s at stage 1, 284 s at stage 25, 10,723 s in total against Seq-LoRA’s 10,463 s.
OPHSD, which regenerates its teacher context by rollouts at every stage, needs 659,000 s; ACE pays its 15,410 tokens at every inference.
blocks.zh:
一个HERD阶段运行着固定数量的更新和探测器,因此其训练时间轨接答长度,而不是舞台指数:316 s在1,284 s在25,10,723 s在Seq-Lora的10,463 s中.
OPHSD在每一个阶段通过推出来再现教师背景,需要659,000 s;ACE在每个推论中支付15,410个令牌.

blocks.en:
On the first eight tasks (Figure 3 a), HERD’s mean stays within half a point of its stage-8 level throughout, from 0.664 at stage 8 to 0.665 at stage 25.
Every parametric baseline moves more: Seq-LoRA falls to 0.372 at stage 12 before recovering to 0.637, TreeLoRA to 0.593, and OPR and MoRAM decline to 0.621 and 0.625.
On the G-test, the parametric baselines take most of their loss by stage 4 or 8 and then plateau, while HERD loses 1.5 points by stage 4 and 6.3 by stage 25.
The two recursive self-distillation baselines instead drift further at every checkpoint.
OPHSD’s G-test falls through 0.741, 0.661, 0.613, and 0.582 at stages 4, 8, 16, and 25, and its first eight tasks from 0.524 to 0.506.
SDFT, whose teacher is asked to include its thinking process, produces answers that lengthen stage after stage, from 345 tokens on average at stage 1 to the 5,120-token ceiling from stage 17 on; 14,098 of its 17,200 test predictions are cut off, and it ends at AA 0.021 and G-test 0.172.
HERD also distills the model from itself under a privileged context, but its teacher context is a skill and the verified answer rather than text generated by the drifting model, its loss is scored on the verified answer, and two anchors bound drift (§ 2.4 ): the audited stage-25 drifts are 0.021 and 0.041 against budgets of 0.05.
blocks.zh:
在前八项任务(图3a)中,HERD的平均值在整个阶段8的半分之内,从第8阶段的0.664到第25阶段的0.665。
每个参数基线移动得更多:Seq-Lora在恢复到0.637之前在第十二阶段降至0.372;TreatyLora为0.593;OPR和MORAM为0.621和0.625.
在G-测试中,参数基线在第四或第八阶段取出大部分损失,然后取出高原,而HERD在第四阶段取出1.5分,在第二十五条取出6.3分.
在每个检查站,两个递归式自沉基线更进一步漂移。
OPHSD的G测试通过0.741,0.661,0.613和0.582阶段,在4,8,16和25阶段,其前8个任务从0.524到0.506.
SDFT的老师被要求包含其思维过程,生成的答案会从阶段1的平均345个令牌到从第17阶段起的5,120个托肯天花板,在17,200个测试预测中,有14,098个被切断,以AA 0.021和G测试0.172结束.
HERD也从自身在特权上下文中提炼出该模型,但其老师上下文是技巧和被验证的答案而不是由漂移模型生成的文本,其损失被打入被验证的答案上,而两个锚被束缚漂移(§ 2.4):被审计的阶段-25漂移为0.021和0.041,而预算为0.05.

Figure 4 removes or replaces one component of HERD at a time and reports the change after stage 25; Table 3 adds the SFT objective and the ε C \varepsilon_{C} sweep.
Each component protects one quantity.
blocks.zh:
图4一次去掉或替换HERD的一个组件,并在第25阶段后报告变化;表3增加了 SFT 目标与 QQ C\varepsilon {C}扫描.
每个部件都保护一个数量。

blocks.en:
Without skills, the teacher sees only the verified answer and nothing is proposed or committed; memory, probes, and anchors are unchanged.
Acquisition falls by 4.5 points and AA by 5.0, the largest losses in both columns, while forgetting and general capability move by at most a point.
Without both anchors, the harness evolves and nothing constrains the weights: acquisition holds, and retention and general capability are those of a parametric baseline.
OPHSD, whose harness never changes and whose drift is never budgeted, has lower acquisition and a larger general-capability loss than HERD (Acq. 0.639, Δ ​ C min \Delta C_{\min} − 0.645 -0.645 ).
Only the full model, which evolves the harness under constraint, is on the frontier.
blocks.zh:
没有技能,老师只看到经核实的答案,没有建议或承诺;记忆,探针,和锚没有变化.
采购下降了4.5分,AA下降了5.0分,这是两栏中最大的损失,而忘记和一般能力移动最多一个点。
没有两根锚,绳子会演化,没有任何东西会限制重量:获得力,保留力和一般能力是参数基线。
OPHSD的用具从未改变,而且其漂移量从未编入预算,其获得量较低,一般能力损失也比HERD要大(Acq. 0.639, QQ C min-Delta C _{\min} - 0.645-0.645)。
只有完整的模型,也就是在制约下演化出绳索,才处于前沿.

blocks.en:
Filling the memory by uniform sampling under the same budget leaves acquisition within half a point, but forgetting doubles, from 0.010 to 0.020, the value of uniform replay in Table 1 .
The checkpoint probes are drawn from the memory, so uniform selection anchors the checkpoint on records the weights already predict and leaves the hardest earlier records unguarded; the stage-end D C D^{C} stays within budget at 0.034.

检查点探测器取自内存,所以统一选择将检查点锁定在已经预测的重量记录上,并留下最困难的更早记录而无人看守;阶段末 D C DQQC} 保持在预算0.034.

blocks.en:
Without the checkpoint anchor, forgetting rises to 0.030, close to the worst parametric baseline’s 0.032, and the audited D C D^{C} ends at 0.118, more than twice the budget.
Without the base anchor, the checkpoint constraint remains active, but base drift accumulates: the stage-end D 0 D^{0} grows from 0.104 at stage 4 to 0.212 at stage 25, Δ ​ C min \Delta C_{\min} falls from − 0.031 -0.031 to − 0.490 -0.490 , and mathematics drops from 0.885 to 0.395 where the full model keeps 0.823.
With neither anchor, forgetting reaches 0.044, above every parametric baseline, and Δ ​ C min \Delta C_{\min} reaches − 0.560 -0.560 , close to their − 0.63 -0.63 to − 0.68 -0.68 .

没有检查站锚地,忘记了上升至0.030,接近最差的参数基线0.032,经审计的DC DQC}以0.118结束,是预算的两倍多。

Replacing distillation by cross-entropy on the verified answers, under the same adapter, budget, and constraints, doubles the general loss, to Δ ​ C \Delta C − 0.123 -0.123 and Δ ​ C min \Delta C_{\min} − 0.320 -0.320 , with both audited drifts within budget; this suggests that the teacher distribution limits drift where the probes do not reach.
The budget ε C \varepsilon_{C} trades forgetting against acquisition in the expected direction (Appendix C ).
Attaching the stage-25 harness at inference reduces forgetting by 0.3 points and changes the other metrics by at most 0.2 points (last row).

预算 \ C\ varepsilon \ C } 交易 忘记了预期方向的收购( 附录 C )。

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
Surveys group LLM continual learning by training stage ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) ; we group it by where experience is kept.
Structural methods isolate task updates in low-rank subspaces, adapter trees, per-task experts, or retained prompts and modules ( Wang et al., 2023a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Razdaibiedina et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) .
Replay methods synthesize or select the data mixed into training ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) .
Self-supervised methods write their own fine-tuning data ( Zweiger et al., 2025 ) , distill from a demonstration-conditioned self ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) , or consolidate fast memories into stable weights ( Behrouz et al., 2026 ) .
Other work finds part of measured forgetting spurious ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , consolidates in weight space ( Cho et al., 2026 ) , or reports limits of on-policy self-distillation ( Wang et al., 2026a ) .
HERD also updates low-rank factors by self-distillation, but a harness decides what to internalize and drift budgets bound each step.
blocks.zh:
调查组通过培训阶段不断学习LLM(Wu等人,2024年;Shi等人,2025年;我们按保存经验的地点分类)。
结构方法在低等亚空间隔离任务更新,适配树,每个任务专家,或保留了提示和模块(Wang等,2023a;Yang等,2026;Qian等,2025;Lu等,2026;Razdaibiedina等,2023;赵等,2024).
重放方法合成或选取混入训练的数据(黄等,2024;陈等,2026;冯等,2026;李等,2026).
自我监督的方法会写出自己的微调数据(Zweiger等,2025年),从有演示条件的自体中分馏出(Shenfeld等,2026年),或将快记忆整合为稳定重量(Behrouz等,2026年).
其他工作发现部分被测量的遗忘假象(郑等,2025年),在重量空间中被巩固(Cho等,2026年),或报告关于政策自我消化的限制(Wang等,2026年a). 。 。 。 。
HERD也通过自沉来更新低等因素,但由一机决定如何将预算内化和漂移将每个步骤相接.

blocks.en:
Non-parametric methods adapt an external memory, context, or harness around a fixed model, where the stability–plasticity tension reappears through retrieval ( Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) .
Recent systems consolidate memory banks ( Ye et al., 2026a ) , evolve contexts into playbooks ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , gate harness edits on improvement and retention checks ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , or refine harnesses over task streams ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
All pass experience through a bounded context, so nothing accumulates in the model itself (§ 1 ).
HERD keeps such a harness as its fast layer but internalizes it into the weights after every stage.
blocks.zh:
非参数化方法调整外部记忆、上下文或围绕固定模型加以利用,其中稳定性-弹性张力通过检索而再现(Gutiérrez等,2025;Hu等,2026)。
近期系统整合了记忆库(Ye等,2026a),将上下文演化为游戏本(Zhang等,2026c),闸机自剪取出改进和保留检查(Kang等,2026),或精炼自剪取出任务流(Wei等,2026;刘等,2026).
所有这些经验都通过一个有界限的上下文传递,所以模型本身没有积累(§ 1).
HERD保持像它的快地层一样的牵引力,但在每个阶段后将其内化入重量.

blocks.en:
A few methods combine the two.
OEL consolidates deployment experience online ( Ye et al., 2026b ) , Continual Harness updates the model from teacher-relabeled harness rollouts ( Karten et al., 2026 ) , and EvoSC consolidates trajectories into soft prompts ( Yu et al., 2026 ) .
HERD keeps only skills and the high-residual samples they miss, and deploys the weights alone.
blocks.zh:
几种方法结合了两者.
OEL整合了在线部署经验(Ye等,2026b),Continual Harness从教师再贴标签的吊带推出(Karten等,2026)中更新了模型,而EvoSC整合了轨迹为软导出(Yu等,2026).
HERD只保留技能和他们错过的高残留样品,单独部署重量.

blocks.en:
Context distillation internalizes instructions and examples into the weights ( Snell et al., 2022 ) .
On-policy variants condition the teacher on experiential knowledge ( Ye et al., 2026c ) or on a harness ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and RL’s Razor ties forgetting to the distributional shift that on-policy training keeps small ( Shenfeld et al., 2025 ) .
HERD’s privileged teacher is of this kind, but it keeps the harness across stages where OPHSD discards it, bounds drift explicitly, and scores verified answer prefixes instead of student rollouts.
Self-Harness accepts edits only after regression testing on fixed benchmarks ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) ; HERD’s commit gate is a simpler version of the same check (§ 2.3 ).
Two evaluations separate updating a harness from benefiting from it ( Lin et al., 2026 ) and ask whether optimizer gains compound over a continual stream ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
上下文分馏将说明和实例内化为权重(Snell等,2022.).
政策变体使教师具备经验性知识(Ye等人,2026c)或系于一系(Zhao等人,2026年),RL的Razor关系忘记了政策性培训所保持的小规模分配转变(Shenfeld等人,2025年)。
HERD的特权教师就是这种类型的,但是它使这个带子跨越了OPHSD丢弃它,界限清晰地漂移,分数经过核实的回答前缀而不是学生推出的阶段.
Self-Harness只在对固定基准进行回归测试后接受编辑(Zhang等,2026a;HERD的承诺门是同一检查的更简单版本(§ 2.3).
两项评价将利用这一优势来更新一个带子(Lin等人,2026年),并询问是否通过连续流来优化收益复合(Wang等人,2026年b) 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented HERD, a hybrid continual learning system that learns in the harness and internalizes it into the weights.
The harness evolves with the stream, iterating on its skills to abstract reusable patterns and keeping the high-residual samples they do not cover in a bounded memory.
Distillation then internalizes the harness under drift constraints with two anchors, the previous checkpoint for per-stage drift and the base model for cumulative drift; only the weights are deployed.
On the 25-stage TRACE+17 stream, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in acquisition, forgets the least among weight-updating methods that avoid collapse, and loses the least general capability.
Removing any part costs acquisition, retention, or general capability, and attaching the final harness at inference barely changes the scores.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了HERD, 一个混合的继续学习系统, 学习在绳子上,并把它内化到重量中。
牵引力随溪流而演化,仰慕其能抽象出可再用模式的技巧,并保留它们没有覆盖的高活性样本入入有界记忆.
蒸发在漂流限制下,再用两根锚将吊带内化,即前一个每相漂流的检点和累积漂流的基模型;只部署重量.
在25相的TRACE+17流上,HERD与获取中最强的参数基线相匹配,忘记了避免倒塌的减重方法中最小的,并失去了最弱的一般能力.
取消任何部分成本 获取,保留,或一般能力, 附加最后的利用 推论 几乎没有改变分数。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our empirical validation is currently scoped to one base model and one 25-stage stream rather than a large-scale sweep.
HERD also relies on a verified answer y ∗ y^{*} for every training record and assumes a stream with known task boundaries, one task per stage, and no revisits.
A detailed discussion regarding these boundaries and the corresponding plans is provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
我们的经验验证目前范围为一基模型和一相25相流,而不是大规模扫荡.
HERD还依赖于每个训练记录中经过核实的答案 y y y 并假设一个已知任务界限的流,每个阶段一个任务,并且不重审.
附录E详细讨论了这些边界和相应的计划。

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实施情况

blocks.en:
TRACE+17 is built once, with seed 42, from pinned revisions of the TRACE and Super-NaturalInstructions repositories: the eight TRACE tasks in their canonical order, then SuperNI tasks 024, 074, 195, 511, 1219, 574, 192, 177, 064, 346, 108, 111, 1415, 1447, 828, 1728, and 217.
Prompts are deduplicated and the splits drawn in a seeded hash order.
Each task keeps its official metric: exact match, leading-choice accuracy, ROUGE-L ( Lin, 2004 ) , edit similarity, or SARI ( Xu et al., 2016 ) .
Validation targets and test records are hidden from the model, and no test score selects a candidate or hyperparameter.
The G-test draws from pinned snapshots of MMLU, GSM8K, HellaSwag, IFEval, and XCOPA, disjoint from the stream: 200 test items per category, a 40-item probe nested in them, and a separate 40-item development panel.
Stage 0 is the base model.
After stage t t we score the current task; at stages 4, 8, 16, and 25 every seen task and the full G-test; at stages 12 and 20 tasks 1 to 8; at every other stage the 200-item probe.
Each cell uses all 100 test items, decoded greedily with thinking off, at most 5,120 new tokens, and 16,384 input tokens; an input over the ceiling counts as an empty prediction.
LoRA baselines decode merged checkpoints with vLLM 0.31.0 ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) ; HERD and MoRAM decode with Transformers; frozen-model methods use MLX ( Hannun et al., 2023 ) , PyTorch’s MPS backend, 2 2 2 https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/notes/mps.html or vLLM servers.
GSM8K is scored on the final number, IFEval by its strict verifier, and the choice categories by one extractor that reads the last explicit answer.

blocks.en:
Every weight-updating method trains for 32 updates of 32 records per stage on sequences of at most 16,384 tokens; longer records are excluded, not truncated.
Unless the official code fixes otherwise, the adapter is a rank-32 LoRA with α = 64 \alpha=64 and no dropout on every linear layer of the text backbone, trained with AdamW at 10 − 4 10^{-4} and gradient clipping at 1.0.
Uniform replay keeps a 32,768-token memory, 8,192 of them for 23 reserved general records, filled by uniform sampling without re-entry.
OPR-RU samples one response per earlier training prompt at temperature 0.1 and keeps the best-scoring five per stage (replay ratio 0.01), with an equal quota per task.
TreeLoRA uses the authors’ regularizer weight of 0.5.
MoRAM follows the official runner: eight rank-1 atoms per module per stage, α = 16 \alpha=16 , dropout 0.1, top-8 self-activation at temperature 0.03 with an inference gate of 0.2, and Adam ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) at 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} .
SDFT trains a fresh adapter per stage on 32 of its own rollouts per update, at temperature 1 and at most 1,024 new tokens; its teacher is an EMA copy (0.01) of the stage-start weights shown the reference under the official thinking-process template.
OPHSD uses the official draft-verify harness on the six stages with at most ten labels and plan-solve elsewhere; the teacher is the stage-start model given the draft labels, or the plan and the reference answer, and the student minimizes the reverse KL on one on-policy rollout per record.

blocks.en:
The static harness wraps the frozen model in a fixed system prompt, an empty skill registry, and a Python tool in a 10-second sandbox, for at most 32 turns per item.
ACE runs the official offline trainer: batch size 1, one epoch, three reflection rounds, ADD-only curation, the upstream 4,096-token call limit, and a rollback of any sample whose call exceeds the input ceiling.
HCL-Stable proposes one alternative per component per stage under a 12,000-token budget and commits it only on a validation gain of at least 0.01 that breaks no item of each earlier task’s 20-item validation panel.
Learning methods run with seeds 42, 43, and 44 and report the mean and sample standard deviation; intervals are 95% item bootstraps with 4,000 draws, resampled within task and G-test category and paired between HERD and each baseline.

Figure 9 follows single test items through the stream.
The first two tasks, C-STANCE and FOMC, train on one-letter answers, and 32 cross-entropy updates on them make the short answer a habit: from stage 2 on, the four parametric baselines answer GSM8K with a bare number, median 3 tokens.
On the Cho and Chloe item (Figure 9 a), the base and HERD write the same three-step derivation to 67 at stages 2 and 25, while Seq-LoRA, uniform replay, OPR, and TreeLoRA guess 10, 11, 14, and 14, then 26, 13, 31, and 22.
The behaviours part at the first tokens, where the base anchor looks: in stage 1 of seed 42, one update lifts D 0 D^{0} to 0.192, λ 0 \lambda_{0} climbs to 2.5, and the drift is back under 0.05 before the stage ends.
At stage 6 (Figure 9 b), NumGLUE-cm prompts differ from GSM8K’s by one word and demand a bare number.
HERD’s stage-6 skill says so and is routed to the NumGLUE prefix alone: HERD answers 4320 on the Oliver item and keeps a 211-token chain on the GSM8K item, every parametric baseline answers both with a number, and the base, the static harness, and HCL derive 4320 inside a sentence and score zero.
blocks.zh:
图9显示的是经过溪流的单个试验项目。
前两个任务,C-STANCE和FOMC,用一字母的答案来训练,上面的32个交叉交替更新使简短的答案成为一种习惯:从第2阶段起,四个参数基线用一个空数回答GSM8K,中值为3个符.
在Cho和Chloe项目(图9a)上,基和HERD在阶段2和25写出相同的三步衍生到67个,而Seq-LORA则统一回放,OPR,和TreeLORA猜想10,11,14和14,然后是26,13,31和22.
行为部分在一号地标上,底锚外观: 在种子42的一号地标上,一个更新将D0 D^{0}升至0.192, λ0\lambda_{0}升至2.5, 在舞台结束前漂移回了0.05以下.
在第六阶段(图9b),NumGLUE-cm提示与GSM8K不同,只用一个字,只要求一个空数。
HERD的舞台-6技巧也这么说, HERD在Oliver项目上回答4320,并在GSM8K项目上保留了一条有211个托肯的链条,每个参数基线都用数字回答,而基数,静态拉带,而HCL在句子内得到4320分并得分为零.

blocks.en:
Some losses never reach Table 1 .
After stage 12, superni:511 with free-text summaries, Seq-LoRA’s C-STANCE, FOMC, and ScienceQA fall to 0.03, 0.05, and 0.15 and are back at 0.69, 0.76, and 0.89 by stage 16 (Figure 9 c).
The knowledge is intact: it answers FOMC with “dovish” or “hawkish” instead of a letter, and mapping the words back gives 0.82, its stage-8 score.
HERD’s checkpoint probes open with the letter itself, so the same shift registers as D C D^{C} : the three seeds peak at 0.114 to 0.136, λ C \lambda_{C} rises to 0.76 to 1.99, the stage ends at 0.020 to 0.051, and FOMC stays at 0.75 to 0.80.
On MeetingBank, learned at stage 3, HERD’s three seeds still write the ordinance title of item 65 at stage 25 (ROUGE-L 0.73) where Seq-LoRA writes “The bill was passed.” (0.00), without replaying any earlier answers.
blocks.zh:

12阶段后,超能:511带有自由文本摘要,Seq-LORA的C-STANCE,FOMC,和ScienceQA降为0.03,0.05和0.15并回到了0.69,0.76和0.89到第16阶段(图9 c.
知识是完好无损的:它用“dovish”或“hawkish”来回答FOMC, 而不是用一封信来回答,
HERD的检查站探测器随信本身而打开,所以与DC DQQC}相同的换乘登记: 3个种子最高峰为0.114至0.136,QQ C\lambda_{C}升至0.76至1.99,阶段以0.020至0.051结束,FOMC保持0.75至0.80.

blocks.en:
The first limitation is probe coverage.
Protection follows the residual memory (Figure 9 d,e): a learned task has low residual, leaves the memory, and loses its checkpoint probes with it.
Superni:192, copying the sentence that supports a given answer, lost its last probe at stage 17 in all three seeds; seed 42 then fell from 0.83 to 0.52 by stage 25, 70 of its 100 outputs copying the answer already in the input, while seeds 43 and 44 held above 0.90.
At stage 25, nine or ten of the 24 earlier tasks have no probe; a floor of probes per learned task is the obvious repair.
The second limitation is skill quality.
For superni:074, writing a question about a passage, seed 42’s skill demands a question and 89 of 100 outputs are questions; the skills of seeds 43 and 44 list a question under Avoid that recurs under Examples, and only 21 and 64 outputs are questions, for ROUGE-L of 0.326 and 0.349 against the base’s 0.421.
The guard passed all three, as it passed all 75 commits.
It checks the window’s mean residual without replaying the answer (Eq. 7 ); improvement under verified-answer prefixes does not guarantee that free generation follows the skill’s intended format.
The third limitation is probe length.
Anchors compare 32 tokens, so on IFEval items with a minimum word count HERD opens like the base, then stops at 232 to 258 words against the base’s 499; its pass rate on these 17 items falls from 0.71 to 0.76 at stage 4 to 0.18 to 0.24 at stage 25, against the base’s 0.94.
Finally, the budget is a mean over a group’s probes and tokens, so a few prompts can flip while the stage-end D 0 D^{0} stays under 0.05: by stage 25, seeds 42 and 43 answer 44 and 60 of the 200 GSM8K items with a bare number, seed 44 only 6, at an accuracy still of 0.81 to 0.83.
blocks.zh:
第一个限制是探测覆盖。
保护跟随残余内存(图9 d,e):一个被学习到的任务残余度较低,留下了内存,并随之失去了它的检查站探测器.
Superni:192,复制了支持一个给定答案的句子,在17期所有三种种子中都失去了最后的探针;而后第42个种子在25期从0.83下降到了0.52,其100个产出中有70个已经复制了输入中的答案,而第43和44个种子持有0.90以上.
在25阶段,早期的24个任务中有9个或10个没有探测器;每个学习到的任务都有一层探测器是明显的修复.
第二个限制因素是技能质量。
对于Suni:074,写一个关于段落的问题,种子42的技能要求提问,100个产出中有89个是问题;种子43和44的技能列出了一个“避免”下的问题,这个问题在“实例”下重复,而只有21和64个产出是问题,而ROUGE-L的0.326和0.349是问题。
警卫通过了所有三个,因为它通过了所有75项承诺。
它检查窗口的平均剩余部分而不重放答案(Eq. 7);在经核实的答案前缀下改进并不能保证自由生成遵循技能的预定格式.
第三个限制是探针长度.
指针比较了32个指针,因此在IFEval项目上,最小字数HERD会像基座一样打开,然后以232到258个字来比对基座的499;它在这17个项目的通过率从第4阶段的0.71到第0.18到第25阶段的0.24,比对基座的0.94.
最后,预算是一组探测器和道具之上的平分,所以在阶段末 D 0 D^{0} 仍停留在0.05以下时,几个提示可以翻转: 按第25阶段,种子42和43回答44和60,200个GSM8K项目中,种子44只6个,精确度仍为0.81至0.83.

blocks.en:
OPHSD’s outputs stay clean to the end, at most 1.3% cut off, and its gains fall on the tasks the base gets right in the wrong format, ScienceQA from 0.03 to 0.85 and NumGLUE from 0 to about 0.5.
The official solve message gives the teacher a plan and a “Reference answer (for verification only)”, and the student, whose prompt holds neither, begins to cite them (Figure 9 f): the share of test outputs that mention a plan or reference answer rises from 0.01 at stage 1 to 0.17 at stage 25, and to 0.84 on the mathematics items, whose outputs shorten from about 1,180 to 405 tokens.
Mathematics ends at 0.24 and instruction following at 0.38, against the base’s 0.89 and 0.82, with planning-style openers in about 37% of answers against 4% for the base.
The harness is run by the current student and the teacher is the stage-start model, so nothing pulls back: the general probe never rises at any of the 25 stages.
blocks.zh:
OPHSD的输出直到最后保持干净,最多被切断了1.3 % , 其收益落在了基础以错误的格式获得的任务上, ScienceQA从0.03到0.85,NumGLUE从0到0.5左右.
官方的解答信息给了老师一个计划和一个“参考答案(仅供核实)”,而学生的即时解答(图9f)也开始引用这些答案(图9f):提到计划或参考答案的测试产出份额从第1阶段的0.01上升到第25阶段的0.17;数学项目的0.84,其产出从约1 180个符号缩短到405个符号。
数学在0.24分结束,在0.38分结束,在0.89分和0.82分结束,在大约37%的答案和4%的回答中,有规划式的开放器。
牵引装置由现在的学生操作,而老师是舞台起动模型,所以没有什么能拉倒:一般探测器在25个阶段的任何阶段都从未起起动.

blocks.en:
SDFT’s teacher prompt shows an example and asks for “a response of your own, including the thinking process”.
Here the example is a one- to three-token label, so the teacher invents a thinking process, and rollouts cut at 1,024 tokens are trained on regardless, so stopping is never supervised.
The drift compounds: test outputs cut at the 5,120-token ceiling go from 0.01 at stage 1 to 0.21, 0.74, and 0.94 at stages 4, 8, and 12, and the share that reproduces the teacher’s instruction verbatim from 0.00 to 0.23, 0.77, and 0.95.
On C-STANCE item 0, stage 12 gives the letter, then “This is an example for a response to the question:” and a new thinking process, restarted until the ceiling (Figure 9 f).
The loss gives no warning, settling at 0.005 to 0.008, because the teacher is an EMA of the student.
HERD’s target is the verified answer replayed as the model’s own turn, so there is no instruction text to copy, and its KL is scored on that answer’s prefix rather than on the student’s samples, where teacher and student can agree on a degenerate path.
blocks.zh:
SDFT的老师提示举出一例,
这里的例子是一个一到三根的标签, 所以老师发明了一个思考过程, 剪去1,024个符牌的推出被训练了不管怎样, 所以停止永远不会被监督。
漂移化合物:从第一阶段的0.01到0.21、0.74和4、8和12阶段的0.94,试验结果从0.00到0.23、0.77和0.95。
在C-STANCE项目0上,第12阶段给出了这个字母,然后“这是回答问题的一个例子”和一个新的思维过程,重新开始,直到天花板(图9f)。
损失没有发出警告,在0.005至0.008之间定居,因为教师是学生的EMA。
HERD的目标是将经过核实的答案重放为模型自己的转折,因此没有可复制的指令文本,其KL被打入该答案的前缀而不是学生的样本上,老师和学生可以在其中商定一条堕落的道路.

blocks.en: Appendix E Future Works
blocks.zh: 附录E 未来工程

blocks.en: Our experiments cover one base model and one 25-stage stream; given HERD’s forgetting of 0.010 and fixed per-stage cost (§ 3.2 ), we plan to test longer streams with more task families.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验包括一个基础模型和一个25级流;鉴于HERD忘记了0.010和固定的每级成本(§3.2),我们计划用更多的任务家庭来测试更长的流.

blocks.en: Our long-term goal is a continual learner that trains recursively on a user’s own harness, the prompts, skills, and memories they already write (§ 1 ), and so internalizes their organization’s procedures, domain knowledge, and codebases.
blocks.zh: 我们的长期目标是一个不断学习的人,他们用用户自己的能力、动机、技能和记忆(第1节)反复训练,从而将组织的程序、领域知识和代码库内部化。

blocks.en:
User harnesses supply neither verified answers nor task boundaries.
To reduce the dependence on y ∗ y^{*} , we are considering: (i) computing the residual and the guard on an accepted target other than y ∗ y^{*} , such as a user correction, a rubric, or a majority answer from several harness rollouts; (ii) opening a stage when the mean residual of incoming records rises and closing it when it falls; and (iii) routing skills by retrieval over the record rather than by a template prefix, so that one stage may hold several tasks.
blocks.zh:
用户使用不提供经核实的答案或任务边界 。
为了减少对y * y 的依赖,我们正在考虑:(一) 计算除y * y 外的被接受目标上的剩余和后卫,例如用户修正,一个字段,或从几个拉带推出的多数答案;(二) 打开一个阶段,当收到的记录的平均后余部分上升,当记录下降时关闭;(三) 通过检索记录而不是一个模板前缀来引导技能,以便一个阶段可以承担几个任务.

blocks.en: Because the harness HERD evolves at one stage is distilled into the weights that evolve it at the next, the loop could extend to recursive self-improvement ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) : (i) letting the current checkpoint rather than the frozen θ 0 \theta_{0} write the skill (§ 2.3 ), so that a model that has internalized one stage writes a better skill for the next; (ii) placing the drift budgets, window size, and record selection in the harness, where the model proposes changes adopted only after a controlled commit; and (iii) applying the same residual test and drift audit to every self-proposed change, with rollback when a gate fails.
blocks.zh: 由于一个阶段的钢带HERD会演化为下一个阶段进化的重量,循环可以扩展到递归自改进(Zhang等,2026b) : (一) 让当前检查站而不是被冻结的 θ 0\theta_{0}写作技能(§ 2.3),这样一个将一个阶段内化的模型为下一个阶段写出更好的技能; (二) 将漂移预算,窗口大小,并记录在钢带中的选择,模型在控制下的承诺之后才提出修改建议; (三) 对每一个自我提出的修改适用相同的剩余测试和漂移审计,当一个大门失效时回滚回.
